html:
Experience a unique and unforgettable adventure with Vietlook Travel is Walking Under the Sea Tour. This tour allows you to walk on the ocean floor and explore the colorful underwater world safely, even if you have no diving experience. With professional equipment and dedicated diving instructors, you will discover the magical beauty of coral reefs and tropical marine life in Nha Trang Bay.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00
Car and professional English-speaking tour guide pick you up at the meeting point.

09:00 – BAI TRANH BEACH
Arrive at Bai Tranh Beach.

Walking Under the Sea Experience

  • Experience walking underwater with professional scuba diving equipment

  • Guided closely by a team of certified and experienced diving instructors

  • Join a short 3-minute briefing on underwater hand signals and safety rules

  • Explore the colorful ocean world with hundreds of coral and fish species

  • Underwater walking time: approximately 15 minutes

10:00
Free time to rest, relax, and swim at two beach areas:

  • One side with fine white sand

  • One side with natural gravel beach

11:30
Have lunch at a floating restaurant in the fishing village.

13:30
Canoe transfer back to the mainland port. End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 42

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Hotel pick-up by car

  • Speed canoe transportation

  • Lunch at the island / fishing village

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Professional diving equipment

  • Bottled water

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional services outside the program

IMPORTANT NOTE

For safety reasons, this tour is not suitable for guests who have:

  • Cardiovascular or heart-related diseases

  • High blood pressure

  • Pregnant women

  • Other serious medical conditions related to diving activities
